cuts.ofreeRecent: standing; a castle bathhouse with a stone pool — dries her hair with a towel; a hilltop lookout over a wide valley — standing; the grand staircase of an old castle — holds a small hand lantern low at her side; her living room with a deep sofa — sitting on the ground; the Wuhou Shrine in Chengdu — holds a white feather fan in both hands in front of her chest; her crew cabin aboard a starship — holds a book closed against her chest; a restored wooden plank road bolted to a sheer cliff in Sichuan — standing; the Zhuge Liang shrine on the Wuzhang Plains plateau — holds a bound bundle of bamboo slips against her chest; a castle bathhouse with a stone pool — perched on a ledge or edge; the rail of a harbour ferry deck in the wind — holds a cup at chest height; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — standing; a cable car cabin over a misty valley — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck
